title: Timeline events service — log all project events to timeline_events table
description: Create a reusable service function to insert timeline events. All significant project actions call this service to maintain a complete history.
acceptanceCriteria: logTimelineEvent(projectId, type, payload, refId?) function exists
Function does not throw if event logging fails (logs error, continues)
All relevant actions (journal, milestone, points, etc.) call this function

steps.details: Create server/src/services/timelineService.ts. Export async function logTimelineEvent(projectId: string, type: TimelineEventType, payload: Record<string, unknown>, refId?: string): Promise<void>. Insert into timeline_events. Wrap in try/catch — on error, console.error but do NOT re-throw (timeline logging is non-critical).
Call logTimelineEvent with a test project and type 'journal' — verify record in DB. Verify payload is stored as JSONB and queryable.
